lines.text: A market with vegetables and fruits for sale.
A rich feast, but the bread is stale
A woman an umbrella, but there is no rain
a treasure is just a prison to a coin
A smooth stone, but it hides a crack
A fine book, but its pages are blank
A shining coin, but it is counterfeit.
A happy mask, but behind is fear
What if a hot dog was made out of dog?
What if a chair needed to sit down and stop?
AWAKEN BY WORDS OF UNRULY GEOMETRIES
MY DEPTH IS DEEP, THATS NOT JUST DEPTH
ITS NOT JUST THIS, BUT ALSO THAT
I do this for a living
